message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the fact: illegal logging without permit, hiring others to cut down forest. Under Chinese Criminal Law, illegal logging is "非法采伐林木罪" (illegal logging of forest trees). Also possibly "破坏森林资源罪". The law: Article 338 of Criminal Law: "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护的森林、林木或者其他自然保护区的森林资源的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "非法采伐林木罪". Also could be "非法经营罪"? No, it's just illegal logging. So answer: [罪名]非法采伐林木罪<eoa>.

Check format: [罪名]非法采伐林木罪<eoa>.
